meta_description: See what you keep from a 401(k) or IRA withdrawal after federal and state withholding, fees and the 10% early penalty, or the gross to request for a target.
subtitle: Find what you actually receive from a retirement account withdrawal after tax withholding, fees and any early-withdrawal penalty, or how much to withdraw to end up with the amount you need.
